meta.name: Ship ClickUp requirements to production with Claude, Cursor and GitHub

name: AI Requirements to Production Autonomous SDLC Agent

parameters.content:
## AI Requirements → Production Autonomous SDLC Agent

A ClickUp task tagged 'ready-for-ai' flows end-to-end: Claude analyzes the requirement (and asks for clarification if it's ambiguous), designs an architecture, breaks it into subtasks, hands implementation to a Cursor background agent, runs the test suite (looping fixes back to Cursor on failure), opens a PR, runs a security scan, waits for human approval, merges + deploys, then verifies production health — with an automatic rollback + re-verify loop if health doesn't hold.

### How to set up
1. Import this workflow into n8n
2. Add credentials: ClickUp API, Anthropic API (header auth, x-api-key), Cursor API (header auth), GitHub API, CI platform (header auth), security scanner (header auth), deployment platform (header auth), APM/monitoring (header auth), WhatsApp Business Cloud API on every WhatsApp node
3. Edit Set - Config: clickupListId, repoOwner/repoName, cursorApiUrl, ciDispatchUrl, securityScanUrl, deploymentApiUrl, productionHealthApiUrl, maxImplementationAttempts, whatsapp fields
4. Point every Wait node's resume webhook at the matching external event: ClickUp comment reply (clarification), Cursor completion webhook, CI results webhook, security scan results webhook, human approval tool, deployment-complete webhook
5. Activate, or use Manual Trigger with a sample ClickUp task id to test end to end

### Requirements
- ClickUp API access (tasks/comments)
- Anthropic API access (Claude)
- Cursor API access (background agents)
- GitHub API access (branches, PRs, merges)
- CI platform API + webhook (test runs)
- Security scanner API + webhook (SAST/dependency scan)
- Deployment platform API + webhook (CD pipeline)
- APM/monitoring API access (post-deploy health)
- WhatsApp Business Cloud API credentials

### A note on autonomy boundaries
This workflow automates analysis, implementation, and verification, but keeps two hard human gates: PR approval before merge, and rollback still notifies a human even though it self-triggers. Nothing merges or stays deployed without a human-visible checkpoint.

## 1. Intake & Requirement Analysis (with clarification loop)

Webhook - ClickUp Requirement Ready fires when a task is tagged 'ready-for-ai' (or use Manual Trigger to test). HTTP Request - Fetch ClickUp Requirement Details pulls the full task body/description/comments.

HTTP Request - Claude: Analyze Requirement asks Claude for a strict-JSON structured analysis: clarity score, extracted acceptance criteria, and any open questions. JS - Parse Requirement Analysis parses that JSON safely.

IF - Requirement Clear Enough checks clarityScore against threshold and whether openQuestions is empty:
- NOT clear: HTTP Request - Post Clarification Comment to ClickUp posts the open questions, then Wait - For Human Clarification pauses on a webhook until someone replies in ClickUp — then loops back to re-fetch and re-analyze.
- Clear: continues to architecture.

## 2. Architecture & Task Breakdown

HTTP Request - Claude: Design Architecture takes the clarified requirement and asks Claude for a structured architecture plan (affected services, data model changes, API changes, risk notes).

HTTP Request - Claude: Break Down Into Tasks turns that architecture into an ordered list of implementation subtasks with estimates.

HTTP Request - Create ClickUp Subtask runs once per subtask item (n8n executes the node per input item automatically). Aggregate - Recombine After Subtask Creation folds everything back into a single item so exactly one Cursor implementation run is triggered for the whole feature, not one per subtask.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Cursor Implementation & Test Loop

parameters.content:
## 3. Implementation & Test-Fix Loop

HTTP Request - Trigger Cursor Background Agent hands the architecture + task breakdown + target repo/branch to Cursor. Wait - For Cursor Implementation Complete pauses on a webhook Cursor calls when it pushes a branch.

HTTP Request - Trigger CI Test Suite dispatches the test run on that branch; Wait - For CI Test Results pauses on the CI webhook.

JS - Evaluate Test Results & Track Attempts parses pass/fail and increments an attempt counter carried on the item.

IF - Tests Passed:
- Fail + attempts remain: HTTP Request - Send Failure Feedback to Cursor Agent sends the failure log back to Cursor, then loops to Wait - For Cursor Implementation Complete for the next push.
- Fail + attempts exhausted: WhatsApp - Alert Implementation Failed escalates to a human and the case stops here.
- Pass: continues to PR creation.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - PR, Security Scan & Approval Gate

parameters.content:
## 4. Pull Request, Security Scan & Human Approval

HTTP Request - Create Pull Request opens the PR from the Cursor branch against the base branch.

HTTP Request - Trigger Security Scan kicks off SAST/dependency scanning on the PR; Wait - For Security Scan Results pauses on the scanner's webhook. JS - Evaluate Security Scan Results parses severity counts.

IF - Security Scan Passed: any critical/high finding routes to WhatsApp - Alert Security Blocked and the case stops for manual triage (no auto-fix loop for security — these need human judgment).

Passing scans reach WhatsApp - Request Human Approval, which links the PR and summary. Wait - For Approval Confirmation pauses on the approval tool's webhook. IF - Approved: rejection closes the PR and notifies; approval continues to merge + deploy. This is the workflow's hard human gate — nothing merges without it.

nodes.name: Sticky Note - Deployment & Production Verification Loop

parameters.content:
## 5. Merge, Deploy & Production Verification

HTTP Request - Merge Pull Request merges once approved. HTTP Request - Trigger Deployment Pipeline kicks the CD pipeline; Wait - For Deployment Complete pauses on its webhook.

HTTP Request - Fetch Production Health Metrics pulls post-deploy error rate/latency/uptime. JS - Evaluate Production Health compares against baseline thresholds.

IF - Production Healthy:
- Healthy: HTTP Request - Update ClickUp Task (Done) closes the loop back in ClickUp with a summary, and WhatsApp - Send Success Summary notifies the team.
- Unhealthy: HTTP Request - Trigger Automatic Rollback fires immediately (this one step is autonomous — production stability doesn't wait for a human), WhatsApp - Alert Rollback Triggered notifies right away, then Wait - For Post-Rollback Verification Grace Period (time-based) -> HTTP Request - Re-Fetch Production Health -> IF - Rollback Successful closes as rolled-back-safe or escalates further if even the rollback isn't restoring health.
